status: illustrative new-roster questions; not a probability distribution or an importance ranking
selection_basis: Chosen to make the scientific additions reviewable after the independent landscape comparison. Neither predicted tractability nor Lean implementation cost determines inclusion. The original50-scenario coverage stress test remains separate.

scenarios.title: Derandomize polynomial-time logarithmic-space computation
scenarios.notes: BPL keeps both a logarithmic workspace bound and a polynomial worst-case clock. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Make logarithmic-space nondeterminism unambiguous
scenarios.notes: UL permits at most one accepting path on every input. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Deterministically simulate every unambiguous logspace language
scenarios.notes: This does not assume a solution to a promise-only unique-path problem. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Turn unbounded-error logspace computation into bounded-error computation
scenarios.notes: Both endpoints have polynomial clocks; the error gap is the distinction. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Classically simulate bounded-error quantum logspace
scenarios.notes: The quantum computation has logarithmic workspace and polynomial running time. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Match quantum logspace to its unbounded-error counting upper bound
scenarios.notes: An unbounded-time quantum simulation does not establish this polynomial-time inclusion. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Simulate all deterministic logspace languages in uniform logarithmic depth
scenarios.notes: UniformNC1 uses standard extended-connection uniformity, equivalently ALOGTIME. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Simulate uniform logarithmic depth by constant-depth threshold circuits
scenarios.notes: The target TC0 is nonuniform. This hypothesis is distinct from silently treating NC1 as uniform. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Give ordinary NP certificates for real feasibility
scenarios.notes: The inputs are finite binary descriptions; real assignments need not have short rational encodings. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Place real feasibility in the counting hierarchy
scenarios.notes: CH is a union of fixed finite levels, not a hierarchy whose level grows with input length. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Solve every real-feasibility language with bounded-error quantum computation
scenarios.notes: This concerns the total binary decision class, not real-input BSS computation. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Eliminate deterministic adaptive PP-oracle queries
scenarios.notes: PSharpP is the decision class P^PP=P^#P. This alone is not encoded as a collapse of CH. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Collapse the counting hierarchy to deterministic counting-oracle computation
scenarios.notes: The reverse containment is in the baseline. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Place polynomial space in the counting hierarchy
scenarios.notes: The reverse containment is in the baseline. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Remove the extra power of two unentangled quantum proofs
scenarios.notes: The witnesses are unentangled across the two proof registers. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Simulate two unentangled quantum proofs in polynomial space
scenarios.notes: The ordinary baseline upper bound is NEXP, not PSPACE. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Verify nondeterministic exponential time with two unentangled proofs
scenarios.notes: The total NEXP endpoint has the standard total-completion interpretation discussed in the roster dossier. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Classically simulate stoquastic quantum verification
scenarios.notes: StoqMA uses the standard inverse-polynomial-gap threshold union; it is not the NP slice with soundness exactly one half. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Remove interaction from quantum statistical zero knowledge
scenarios.notes: Every input must satisfy the gap; a promise-only theorem needs a valid total-language transfer. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.

scenarios.title: Give quantum witnesses for all quantum statistical zero-knowledge languages
scenarios.notes: No unconditional QSZK⊆QMA or QSZK⊆PP is imported merely from a common PSPACE upper bound. Hypothetical result, not a verified model achievement.
